CVE-2026-48558 SimpleHelp  SimpleHelp SimpleHelp Authentication Bypass Vulnerability SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.
